name: moviechooser
description: Desktop app that recommends movies and series available on streaming platforms
author: PedroEmmanuelBuerger

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.electron:dev: npm run electron:compile && concurrently -k "vite" "wait-on http://localhost:5173 && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 electron ."
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json --noEmit
